items.name: add_filter
items.summary: Returns a new [LogicalPlan] that filters the output of  `plan` with a [LogicalPlan::Filter] with all `predicates` ANDed.

items.name: can_hash
items.summary: Can this data type be used in hash join equal conditions?? Data types here come from function 'equal_rows', if more data types are supported in create_hashes, add those data types here to generate join logical plan.

items.name: check_all_columns_from_schema
items.summary: Check whether all columns are from the schema.

items.name: collect_subquery_cols
items.summary: Determine the set of [`Column`]s produced by the subquery.

items.name: columnize_expr
items.summary: Convert an expression into Column expression if it's already provided as input plan.

items.name: compare_sort_expr
items.summary: Compare the sort expr as PostgreSQL's common_prefix_cmp(): <https://github.com/postgres/postgres/blob/master/src/backend/optimizer/plan/planner.c>

items.name: conjunction
items.signature: fn conjunction(filters: impl IntoIterator<Item = Expr>) -> Option<Expr>
items.summary: Combines an array of filter expressions into a single filter expression consisting of the input filter expressions joined with logical AND.

items.name: disjunction
items.signature: fn disjunction(filters: impl IntoIterator<Item = Expr>) -> Option<Expr>
items.summary: Combines an array of filter expressions into a single filter expression consisting of the input filter expressions joined with logical OR.

items.name: enumerate_grouping_sets
items.summary: Convert multiple grouping expressions into one [`GroupingSet::GroupingSets`],\ if the grouping expression does not contain [`Expr::GroupingSet`] or only has one expression,\ no conversion will be performed.

items.name: expand_qualified_wildcard
items.signature: fn expand_qualified_wildcard(qualifier: &datafusion_common::TableReference, schema: &datafusion_common::DFSchema, wildcard_options: Option<&expr::WildcardOptions>) -> datafusion_common::Result<Vec<Expr>>
items.summary: Resolves an `Expr::Wildcard` to a collection of qualified `Expr::Column`'s.

items.name: expand_wildcard
items.signature: fn expand_wildcard(schema: &datafusion_common::DFSchema, plan: &LogicalPlan, wildcard_options: Option<&expr::WildcardOptions>) -> datafusion_common::Result<Vec<Expr>>
items.summary: Resolves an `Expr::Wildcard` to a collection of `Expr::Column`'s.

items.name: expr_as_column_expr
items.summary: Convert any `Expr` to an `Expr::Column`.

items.name: expr_to_columns
items.summary: Recursively walk an expression tree, collecting the unique set of columns referenced in the expression

items.name: exprlist_to_fields
items.signature: fn exprlist_to_fields<'a>(exprs: impl IntoIterator<Item = &'a Expr>, plan: &LogicalPlan) -> datafusion_common::Result<Vec<(Option<datafusion_common::TableReference>, std::sync::Arc<arrow::datatypes::Field>)>>
items.summary: Create schema fields from an expression list, for use in result set schema construction

items.name: find_aggregate_exprs
items.signature: fn find_aggregate_exprs<'a>(exprs: impl IntoIterator<Item = &'a Expr>) -> Vec<Expr>
items.summary: Collect all deeply nested `Expr::AggregateFunction`. They are returned in order of occurrence (depth first), with duplicates omitted.

items.name: find_column_exprs
items.summary: Collect all deeply nested `Expr::Column`'s. They are returned in order of appearance (depth first), and may contain duplicates.

items.name: find_join_exprs
items.summary: Looks for correlating expressions: for example, a binary expression with one field from the subquery, and one not in the subquery (closed upon from outer scope)

items.name: find_out_reference_exprs
items.summary: Collect all deeply nested `Expr::OuterReferenceColumn`. They are returned in order of occurrence (depth first), with duplicates omitted.

items.name: find_valid_equijoin_key_pair
items.signature: fn find_valid_equijoin_key_pair(left_key: &Expr, right_key: &Expr, left_schema: &datafusion_common::DFSchema, right_schema: &datafusion_common::DFSchema) -> datafusion_common::Result<Option<(Expr, Expr)>>
items.summary: Give two sides of the equijoin predicate, return a valid join key pair. If there is no valid join key pair, return None.

items.name: find_window_exprs
items.signature: fn find_window_exprs<'a>(exprs: impl IntoIterator<Item = &'a Expr>) -> Vec<Expr>
items.summary: Collect all deeply nested `Expr::WindowFunction`. They are returned in order of occurrence (depth first), with duplicates omitted.

items.name: format_state_name
items.summary: Build state name. State is the intermediate state of the aggregate function.

items.name: generate_signature_error_msg
items.summary: Creates a detailed error message for a function with wrong signature.

items.name: generate_sort_key
items.summary: Generate a sort key for a given window expr's partition_by and order_by expr

items.name: group_window_expr_by_sort_keys
items.signature: fn group_window_expr_by_sort_keys(window_expr: impl IntoIterator<Item = Expr>) -> datafusion_common::Result<Vec<(Vec<(expr::Sort, bool)>, Vec<Expr>)>>
items.summary: Group a slice of window expression expr by their order by expressions

items.name: grouping_set_expr_count
items.summary: Count the number of distinct exprs in a list of group by expressions. If the first element is a `GroupingSet` expression then it must be the only expr.

items.name: grouping_set_to_exprlist
items.summary: Find all distinct exprs in a list of group by expressions. If the first element is a `GroupingSet` expression then it must be the only expr.

items.name: inspect_expr_pre
items.signature: fn inspect_expr_pre<F, E>(expr: &Expr, f: F) -> datafusion_common::Result<(), E> where F: FnMut(&Expr) -> datafusion_common::Result<(), E>
items.summary: Recursively inspect an [`Expr`] and all its children.

items.name: iter_conjunction
items.summary: Iterate parts in a conjunctive [`Expr`] such as `A AND B AND C` => `[A, B, C]`

items.name: iter_conjunction_owned
items.signature: fn iter_conjunction_owned(expr: Expr) -> impl Iterator<Item = Expr>
items.summary: Iterate parts in a conjunctive [`Expr`] such as `A AND B AND C` => `[A, B, C]`

items.name: merge_schema
items.summary: merge inputs schema into a single schema.

items.name: only_or_err
items.summary: Returns the first (and only) element in a slice, or an error

items.name: powerset
items.summary: The [power set] (or powerset) of a set S is the set of all subsets of S, \ including the empty set and S itself.

items.name: split_binary
items.summary: Splits an binary operator tree [`Expr`] such as `A <OP> B <OP> C` => `[A, B, C]`

items.name: split_binary_owned
items.signature: fn split_binary_owned(expr: Expr, op: Operator) -> Vec<Expr>
items.summary: Splits an owned binary operator tree [`Expr`] such as `A <OP> B <OP> C` => `[A, B, C]`

items.name: split_conjunction
items.summary: Splits a conjunctive [`Expr`] such as `A AND B AND C` => `[A, B, C]`

items.name: split_conjunction_owned
items.summary: Splits an owned conjunctive [`Expr`] such as `A AND B AND C` => `[A, B, C]`
